profile.tagline: Senior Test Automation Engineer (SDET) for web, API and CI/CD

summary.summary: Eleven years in quality assurance, eight of them in test automation. Builds maintainable end-to-end and API test suites, wires them into pipelines and teaches teams to own their tests.

list.details:
- Built an end-to-end suite with Playwright and TypeScript for a web shop: 1,400 tests, run in Azure DevOps pipelines on every pull request
- API tests for the REST services (orders, payment, inventory) with Playwright and contract tests with Pact
- Cut the flaky test rate from 9% to under 1% through test isolation and stable test data
- Coached three development teams on the test pyramid and code review for tests
- Test reports for product owners in Azure DevOps dashboards

- Migrated 600 Selenium tests (Java) to Playwright, runtime from 3 hours to 25 minutes
- BDD scenarios with Cucumber, written together with the business unit
- API tests with Postman and Newman in the Azure DevOps pipeline
- Set up test data management for contract and claims scenarios

- Selenium WebDriver tests in Java with TestNG for the customer portal
- Mobile tests with Appium for the Android and iOS apps
- Jenkins pipelines for nightly regression runs
- Defect triage together with development in Jira

- Manual and exploratory testing of websites and web applications for agency clients
- First Selenium IDE and WebDriver scripts for smoke tests
- Test documentation in Confluence, bug tracking in Jira

list.title: Test case drafts with an LLM
list.tagline: Internal tool that turns user stories into Playwright test drafts through an LLM API. A tester reviews every draft before it is merged. Used by two teams as a time saver for new features.

list.title: Failure classification dashboard
list.tagline: Collects test results from pipelines and groups failures by cause (test data, timing, environment, real defect). Helps the team decide which failures to look at first.
